entities.name: agg_messages_weekly
entities.sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week, count(*) FILTER (WHERE direction = 'in' AND NOT (b ~* '^(liked|loved|emphasized|laughed at|disliked|questioned) “' OR b ILIKE 'I accept receiving text messages%')) AS n_in, count(*) FILTER (WHERE direction IS DISTINCT FROM 'in' AND NOT (template_code IS NOT NULL OR (coalesce(is_automated, false) AND channel NOT IN ('sms', 'call')))) AS n_out, count(*) FILTER (WHERE direction IS DISTINCT FROM 'in' AND (template_code IS NOT NULL OR (coalesce(is_automated, false) AND channel NOT IN ('sms', 'call')))) AS n_auto FROM (SELECT *, btrim(regexp_replace(coalesce(body, ''), '\s*Chat in Linq:.*$', '')) AS b FROM messages) x WHERE (occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') >= date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') - interval '11 weeks' GROUP BY 1

entities.name: agg_messages_channels
entities.sql: SELECT coalesce(channel, '(не указано)') AS name, count(*) AS n FROM messages WHERE occurred_at >= now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY 1

entities.name: agg_messages_replies
entities.sql: WITH m AS ( SELECT order_id, occurred_at, CASE WHEN direction = 'in' AND (channel = 'call' OR (b ~* '^(liked|loved|emphasized|laughed at|disliked|questioned) “' OR b ILIKE 'I accept receiving text messages%') OR (length(b) <= 40 AND b ~* '^(thank|thx|ok\M|okay|great|perfect|sounds good|got it|awesome|cool|👍|🙏)')) THEN 'skip' WHEN direction = 'in' THEN 'in' WHEN (template_code IS NOT NULL OR (coalesce(is_automated, false) AND channel NOT IN ('sms', 'call'))) THEN 'auto' ELSE 'out' END AS kind FROM (SELECT *, btrim(regexp_replace(coalesce(body, ''), '\s*Chat in Linq:.*$', '')) AS b FROM messages) x WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '120 days' ), manual AS ( SELECT order_id, occurred_at, kind, lag(kind) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY occurred_at) AS prev FROM m WHERE kind IN ('in', 'out') ), turns AS ( SELECT t.order_id, t.occurred_at AS asked, (SELECT min(r.occurred_at) FROM m r WHERE r.order_id = t.order_id AND r.kind = 'out' AND r.occurred_at > t.occurred_at) AS replied FROM manual t WHERE t.kind = 'in' AND (t.prev IS NULL OR t.prev = 'out') ) SELECT 'all' AS scope, count(replied) AS replies, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM replied - asked) / 3600) FILTER (WHERE replied IS NOT NULL) AS median_hours, avg((replied - asked <= interval '1 hour')::int) FILTER (WHERE replied IS NOT NULL) AS within_1h, avg((replied - asked <= interval '24 hours')::int) FILTER (WHERE replied IS NOT NULL) AS within_24h FROM turns WHERE asked >= now() - interval '90 days'

entities.name: agg_messages_waiting
entities.sql: WITH m AS ( SELECT order_id, occurred_at, CASE WHEN direction = 'in' AND (channel = 'call' OR (b ~* '^(liked|loved|emphasized|laughed at|disliked|questioned) “' OR b ILIKE 'I accept receiving text messages%') OR (length(b) <= 40 AND b ~* '^(thank|thx|ok\M|okay|great|perfect|sounds good|got it|awesome|cool|👍|🙏)')) THEN 'skip' WHEN direction = 'in' THEN 'in' WHEN (template_code IS NOT NULL OR (coalesce(is_automated, false) AND channel NOT IN ('sms', 'call'))) THEN 'auto' ELSE 'out' END AS kind FROM (SELECT *, btrim(regexp_replace(coalesce(body, ''), '\s*Chat in Linq:.*$', '')) AS b FROM messages) x WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '120 days' ), manual AS ( SELECT order_id, occurred_at, kind, lag(kind) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY occurred_at) AS prev FROM m WHERE kind IN ('in', 'out') ), turns AS ( SELECT t.order_id, t.occurred_at AS asked, (SELECT min(r.occurred_at) FROM m r WHERE r.order_id = t.order_id AND r.kind IN ('out', 'auto') AND r.occurred_at > t.occurred_at) AS replied FROM manual t WHERE t.kind = 'in' AND (t.prev IS NULL OR t.prev = 'out') ) SELECT o.order_no, o.stage, o.step, round(extract(epoch FROM now() - t.asked) / 3600) AS hours FROM turns t JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = t.order_id WHERE t.replied IS NULL AND t.asked <= now() - interval '2 hours' AND t.asked >= now() - interval '7 days' AND o.stage NOT LIKE 'Closed%' AND o.stage NOT IN ('Done', 'Delivered')

entities.name: agg_sla_weekly
entities.sql: WITH m AS ( SELECT order_id, occurred_at, direction, channel, template_code, coalesce(body, '') AS b FROM messages WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL ), firsts AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (order_id) order_id, occurred_at AS started, direction, channel, b FROM m ORDER BY order_id, occurred_at ), leads AS ( SELECT f.order_id, f.started, f.started AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS loc FROM firsts f JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = f.order_id WHERE f.direction = 'in' AND f.channel IN ('sms', 'email', 'website') AND f.b !~ '^(Liked|Loved|Emphasized|Laughed at|Disliked|Questioned)' AND o.came_via IS DISTINCT FROM 'MP Form' AND o.came_via IS DISTINCT FROM 'Phone Call' AND coalesce(o.sources, '') NOT LIKE '%Facebook%' AND f.started >= now() - interval '130 days' ), due AS ( SELECT l.*, CASE WHEN extract(isodow FROM loc) <= 5 AND loc::time >= '09:00' AND loc::time < '18:00' THEN CASE WHEN date_trunc('day', loc) + interval '18 hours' - loc >= interval '4 hours' THEN loc + interval '4 hours' ELSE (loc::date + CASE extract(isodow FROM loc)::int WHEN 5 THEN 3 WHEN 6 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) + interval '9 hours' + (interval '4 hours' - (date_trunc('day', loc) + interval '18 hours' - loc)) END ELSE CASE WHEN extract(isodow FROM loc) <= 5 AND loc::time < '09:00' THEN loc::date + interval '9 hours' ELSE (loc::date + CASE extract(isodow FROM loc)::int WHEN 5 THEN 3 WHEN 6 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) + interval '9 hours' END + interval '1 hour' END AS deadline FROM leads l ), replied AS ( SELECT d.*, (SELECT min(r.occurred_at) FROM m r WHERE r.order_id = d.order_id AND r.occurred_at > d.started AND ( (r.direction = 'out' AND r.template_code IS NULL AND r.channel IN ('sms', 'email', 'call', 'yelp', 'thumbtack') AND r.b !~ '^(Liked|Loved|Emphasized|Laughed at|Disliked|Questioned)') OR (r.direction = 'in' AND r.channel = 'call' AND r.b ILIKE '%completed%' AND r.b ILIKE '%inbound%'))) AS reply FROM due d ) SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', loc), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week, count(*) FILTER (WHERE deadline < now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') AS leads, count(*) FILTER (WHERE deadline < now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AND (reply IS NULL OR reply AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' > deadline)) AS late, count(*) FILTER (WHERE deadline >= now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') AS pending, count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(isodow FROM loc) <= 5 AND loc::time >= '09:00' AND loc::time < '18:00' AND deadline < now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') AS leads_window, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM reply - started) / 60) FILTER (WHERE reply IS NOT NULL AND extract(isodow FROM loc) <= 5 AND loc::time >= '09:00' AND loc::time < '18:00') AS median_minutes_window FROM replied GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

entities.name: agg_photo_reminder_weekly
entities.sql: WITH m AS ( SELECT order_id, occurred_at, direction, template_code, coalesce(body, '') AS b FROM messages WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL ), asks AS ( SELECT m.order_id, m.occurred_at FROM m JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = m.order_id WHERE m.direction = 'out' AND NOT (o.came_via IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'MP Form' AND coalesce(o.sources, '') LIKE '%Facebook%') AND (coalesce(m.template_code, '') ILIKE '%photo%' OR (m.template_code IS NULL AND m.b ~* '\m(photos?|pictures?|pics?|images?)\M')) ), media AS ( SELECT order_id, occurred_at FROM m WHERE direction = 'in' AND b ~* '(linqapp\.com|public\.blob\.vercel-storage\.com|thumbtack\.com\S*\.jpe?g)' ), firsts AS ( SELECT order_id, min(occurred_at) AS asked FROM asks GROUP BY order_id ), silent AS ( SELECT f.* FROM firsts f WHERE f.asked >= now() - interval '130 days' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media x WHERE x.order_id = f.order_id AND x.occurred_at <= f.asked + interval '1 day') ) SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', asked AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week, count(*) FILTER (WHERE asked <= now() - interval '3 days') AS silent, count(*) FILTER (WHERE asked <= now() - interval '3 days' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asks a WHERE a.order_id = s.order_id AND a.occurred_at > s.asked AND a.occurred_at <= s.asked + interval '3 days' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media x WHERE x.order_id = s.order_id AND x.occurred_at <= a.occurred_at))) AS reminded, count(*) FILTER (WHERE asked > now() - interval '3 days') AS pending FROM silent s GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

entities.name: agg_quote_photo_weekly
entities.sql: WITH m AS ( SELECT order_id, occurred_at, direction, template_code, coalesce(body, '') AS b FROM messages WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL ), photo AS ( SELECT order_id, min(occurred_at) AS photo_at FROM m WHERE direction = 'in' AND b ~* '(linqapp\.com|public\.blob\.vercel-storage\.com|thumbtack\.com\S*\.jpe?g)' GROUP BY order_id ), recent AS ( SELECT p.order_id, p.photo_at, p.photo_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS loc FROM photo p WHERE p.photo_at >= now() - interval '130 days' ), due AS ( SELECT r.*, CASE WHEN extract(isodow FROM loc) <= 5 AND loc::time >= '09:00' AND loc::time < '18:00' THEN CASE WHEN date_trunc('day', loc) + interval '18 hours' - loc >= interval '4 hours' THEN loc + interval '4 hours' ELSE (loc::date + CASE extract(isodow FROM loc)::int WHEN 5 THEN 3 WHEN 6 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) + interval '9 hours' + (interval '4 hours' - (date_trunc('day', loc) + interval '18 hours' - loc)) END ELSE CASE WHEN extract(isodow FROM loc) <= 5 AND loc::time < '09:00' THEN loc::date + interval '9 hours' ELSE (loc::date + CASE extract(isodow FROM loc)::int WHEN 5 THEN 3 WHEN 6 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) + interval '9 hours' END + interval '4 hours' END AS deadline FROM recent r ), quoted AS ( SELECT d.*, least( (SELECT min(q.occurred_at) FROM m q WHERE q.order_id = d.order_id AND q.direction = 'out' AND q.occurred_at >= d.photo_at AND (q.b ~ '\$\s?[0-9]' OR coalesce(q.template_code, '') LIKE '%quote_sent')), (SELECT min(e.sent_at) FROM estimates e WHERE e.order_id = d.order_id AND e.sent_at >= d.photo_at)) AS quote_at FROM due d ) SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', loc), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week, count(*) FILTER (WHERE deadline < now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') AS photos, count(*) FILTER (WHERE deadline < now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AND (quote_at IS NULL OR quote_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' > deadline)) AS late, count(*) FILTER (WHERE deadline < now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AND quote_at IS NULL) AS no_quote, count(*) FILTER (WHERE deadline >= now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') AS pending FROM quoted GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

entities.name: agg_actions_weekly
entities.sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week, author, count(*) AS actions FROM notes WHERE is_system AND author IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= now() - interval '130 days' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

entities.name: agg_site_weekly
entities.sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', started_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week, count(*) AS visits, count(order_id) AS orders FROM site_visits WHERE coalesce(test_tag, '') = '' AND (started_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') >= date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') - interval '11 weeks' GROUP BY 1

entities.name: agg_site_totals
entities.sql: SELECT 'all' AS scope, count(*) AS visits, count(order_id) AS orders FROM site_visits WHERE coalesce(test_tag, '') = '' AND started_at >= now() - interval '90 days'

entities.name: agg_site_sources
entities.sql: SELECT coalesce(nullif(source, ''), CASE WHEN referrer_host LIKE '%google.%' THEN 'Google, поиск' WHEN referrer_host LIKE '%facebook.com' OR referrer_host LIKE '%instagram.com' THEN 'Facebook и Instagram' WHEN referrer_host IS NULL OR referrer_host LIKE '%lerega.com' THEN 'Прямой заход' ELSE 'Другие сайты' END) AS name, count(*) AS visits, count(order_id) AS orders FROM site_visits WHERE coalesce(test_tag, '') = '' AND started_at >= now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY visits DESC LIMIT 10

entities.name: agg_site_devices
entities.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN lower(device) LIKE 'mobile%' THEN 'Телефон' WHEN lower(device) LIKE 'tablet%' THEN 'Планшет' WHEN lower(device) LIKE 'desktop%' THEN 'Компьютер' ELSE coalesce(nullif(device, ''), '(не указано)') END AS name, count(*) AS visits, count(order_id) AS orders FROM site_visits WHERE coalesce(test_tag, '') = '' AND started_at >= now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY visits DESC LIMIT 5

entities.name: agg_site_services
entities.sql: SELECT site_service AS name, count(*) AS visits, count(order_id) AS orders FROM site_visits WHERE coalesce(test_tag, '') = '' AND started_at >= now() - interval '90 days' AND site_service IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY visits DESC LIMIT 10

entities.name: agg_site_landings
entities.sql: SELECT coalesce(nullif(landing_path, ''), '(не указано)') AS name, count(*) AS visits, count(order_id) AS orders FROM site_visits WHERE coalesce(test_tag, '') = '' AND started_at >= now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY visits DESC LIMIT 8
